Series API Reference¶

Back to PlussQit API Reference

This page documents pluss::Series — the numeric/boolean tensor object underneath every numeric Thread column — one method page at a time, with real, compiled-and-run examples under every code block.

Using This Reference¶

  • Use the left sidebar to open one method page at a time.

  • Each method page contains its signature(s), parameter details, a Gradient section for anything differentiable, verified output under every example, and working previous/next navigation.

  • This landing page stays intentionally short so the content panel is not one giant scroll of every method — see Series_Methods for the full method-naming-philosophy note and coden_method_index for a flat cross-referenced index of the entire surface, documented and not yet documented alike.

Coverage¶

Series has roughly 350 distinct method names; this reference currently covers a working subset, prioritized by how load-bearing each method is (indexing/shape, factories, then the autograd-sensitive family) rather than alphabetically. Every page here is real, hand-verified prose — nothing below is a mechanically generated stub.
